settings.title: Settings
settings.plan_desc_trial: 🎁 3-day free PRO+ trial activated. Enjoy all Gemini 3.7 Flash AI features, voice transcription, and cloud sync.
settings.plan_desc_pro_plus: ✨ Full PRO+ subscription active. Built-in Gemini 3.7 Flash AI runs automatically without API keys, including smart reminders and voice input.
settings.plan_desc_pro: ⭐ PRO Lifetime active (Without built-in AI). Cloud sync and PDF export enabled. Add your custom API keys below for AI features.
settings.plan_desc_free: 🆓 You are using the Free version. Upgrade to PRO or PRO+ to unlock Gemini 3.7 Flash AI, voice notes, and cloud sync.
settings.local_mode_desc: You are using the app without an account. Cloud sync is unavailable.
settings.cloud_sync_desc: Enable to use cloud synchronization and backup your files. If disabled, the app works entirely offline.
settings.yandex_disk_desc: Save your notes to Yandex Disk to access them across all your devices.
settings.google_drive_desc: Save your notes to Google Drive. Backup will be securely hidden from prying eyes.
settings.need_pro_sync_desc: Cloud synchronization is only available in PRO version.
settings.need_pro_ai_desc: Configuring custom API keys for unlimited AI access is only available in PRO version.
settings.gemini_desc: Google Gemini API key is required for AI assistant features.
settings.gemini_placeholder_pro_plus: Built-in PRO+ active (or your custom key)
settings.gemini_help_pro_plus: You have a PRO+ subscription with built-in AI. You can leave this empty or enter your custom key.
settings.gemini_help_free: Get a key for free at Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com).
settings.gigachat_desc: GigaChat API authorization credentials (Client Secret / Auth Key) required.
settings.openrouter_desc: OpenRouter provides access to hundreds of AI models (including Gemini, Claude, OpenAI). Connects directly without VPN.
settings.custom_proxy_desc: Enter your custom Cloudflare worker URL.
settings.pin_set: PIN code for secret notes is active.
settings.pin_not_set: PIN code for secret notes is not set. You can set it from the main screen.
